purpose: Describe the quarterly holder composition and net-incurrence decomposition of general-government F3 liabilities using the retained who-to-whom F3 replay, without equating net incurrence with gross issuance, refinancing need, or securities supply pressure.

semantics.stock: Market-valued/ESA financial-account F3 liability stock by holder; not Maastricht gross debt at nominal/face value.
semantics.transaction: Financial-account net incurrence of government F3 liabilities matched to holder net acquisition. Net means issuance less redemptions/repurchases on the instrument boundary; it is not gross issuance.
semantics.combined_nontransaction_change: Revaluations plus other changes in volume combined, inherited from the F3 replay; no causal decomposition.
semantics.holder_share: Holder F3 stock divided by total government F3 liability stock for the quarter.
semantics.concentration_hhi: Sum of squared holder shares; descriptive only, with no concentration threshold or policy interpretation.
